Container.Name: Node-Exporter
Container.Overview: Prometheus exporter for Unraid host hardware and OS metrics using the official distroless image. This template follows the upstream container deployment: it uses the host network and PID namespace, then mounts the host root filesystem read-only at /host. Prepared by the Unraid Secretary Office's consultant: its textfile collector also reads the office's own numbers.
Container.Requires: Docker must be enabled and host TCP port 9100 must be available. The read-only host-root mount exposes host files to the container.

Config.Name: Host root filesystem
Config.Description: The server read-only for node_exporter (Docker makes it rslave by itself, so it sees Unraid's mounts)

Config.Name: Installed by
Config.Description: A note of the Unraid Secretary Office: its consultant prepared this container. Changes nothing.
